cases.title: Compatibility review and a cancelled installer check

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text: Hi, I'm Alex. Let's plan the compatibility work.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Hi, I'm Maya. What do we need?

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text: I'll prepare the compatibility matrix by January twelfth, twenty twenty-seven.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Agreed. Please prepare that matrix for that date.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: I'll test the installer as well.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Actually, cancel my installer test task. The installer is being replaced.

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text: Agreed. The installer test task is cancelled.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: We also need to review the support notes.

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text: Agreed. The support notes review is a confirmed task. Nobody has taken ownership, and we have not agreed a deadline.

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text: We could redraw the toolbar icons.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: That is only a suggestion. We are not approving the new icons.

expected.reason: Alex commits and Maya explicitly agrees to the named date.
The accepted task is explicitly cancelled and the cancellation is acknowledged.
The review is explicitly confirmed with no agreed owner or deadline.
The suggestion is explicitly left unapproved.

clarifications: Assign an owner and agree a deadline for reviewing support notes.
